definitions.full: H7992. shelishi שְׁלִישִׁי masculine שְׁלִישִׁית feminine adjective ordinal number 108 third ; — שְׁלִישִׁי יוֺם Gen 1:13 31 t., etc. (64 t., rarely שְׁלִשִׁי ); plural שְׁלִשִׁים ( third 50, set of messengers, etc.) 1Sam 19:21 ; 2Kin 1:13 4 t.; הַשְּׁלִישִׁית בַּשָּׁנָה 1Kin 18:1 4 t., etc. (33 t.; sometimes שְׁלִשִׁת שְׁלִשִׁית, , etc.); = third part, a third 2Sam 18:2 (3 t. in verse) + 13 t., + (construct) Num 15:6 4 t., + שְׁלִשִׁתֵיךְ (Ges § 91l ) Ezek 5:12 third part of thee; = third time 1Sam 3:8 ; also שְׁלִישִׁיָּה Isa 19:24 third (on par with other two); בַּשְּׁלִישִׁים Ezek 42:3 in the thirds , i.e. third story ; — שׁ ׳עֶגְלַת 15:5 ; Jer 48:34 , see ׳ע p. 722. — שְׁלִישִׁ֫תָה Ezek 21:19 is corrupt and doubtful; Krae proposes וְשֻׁלְּשָׁה the sword shall be doubled and trebled ; other conjectures in Co Toy. 1Sam 20:5 strike out ᵐ5 ׳הַשּׁ We Dr and others, so 20:12 . 2Sam 23:18 read ᵑ6 הַשְּׁלשִׁם We Dr and others
